selection.edition: international CompanyCam Core API v2/v3 covering Composio COMPANYCAM tools
selection.ownership: CompanyCam, Inc. (Lincoln, Nebraska, US construction photo SaaS)

research.searchCoverage: Bounded 2026-09-13 review of official CompanyCam Core API v2 getting-started and OpenAPI pages, help-center API article, company identity (Lincoln NE, US), and dated incident search. This is the documented v2 Core API at api.companycam.com with Bearer access tokens, not the newer developers.companycam.com edition and not OAuth-only partner flow. No qualifying current unresolved incident was identified; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official Core API v2 docs confirm https://api.companycam.com/v2, Authorization Bearer access tokens from app.companycam.com/access_tokens, GET /company, /users/current, /projects, /users, and query names page/per_page/query/modified_since. CompanyCam is a US construction photo SaaS (Lincoln, NE). Official getting-started notes the v2 docs are the legacy Core API depreciating early 2027 in favor of developers.companycam.com; this recipe admits the still-documented v2 edition that matches pinned source as of 2026-09-13.

incidents.finding: Official docs remain live for Core API v2 with Bearer access tokens. Bounded public incident search did not identify a current unresolved CompanyCam compromise. Availability incidents on status pages are operational, not security breaches.
incidents.limitation: Live authentication remains unverified. The v2 Core API is documented as depreciating early 2027; the newer developers.companycam.com edition is not this recipe.

remainingGates: Core API v2 documented as depreciating early 2027; still official and matching pinned source as of 2026-09-13
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

projects.get.description: Retrieve one CompanyCam project by ID.
projects.get.title: Get project

projects.list.description: List CompanyCam projects with optional name/address query and page filters.
projects.list.title: List projects

users.current.title: Get current user

users.list.description: List CompanyCam users with optional page filters.

projects.create.title: Create project
projects.create.description: Create a CompanyCam project via POST /projects. Name is required; address, coordinates, geofence, and primary_contact are optional Core API fields. Optional userEmail is sent as X-CompanyCam-User.

projects.update.title: Update project
projects.update.description: Update a CompanyCam project via PUT /projects/{projectId}. Optional name, address, coordinates, and geofence are sent when set.

projects.search.title: Search projects
projects.search.description: Search CompanyCam projects via GET /projects with a required query (name or address line 1). Optional page, perPage, modifiedSince, and status filters match the Core API list endpoint.

query.description: Filter by name or first address line.

perPage.description: Results per page (sent as per_page, max 100).

comments.add.title: Add comment
comments.add.description: Add a comment to a CompanyCam project or photo via POST /{commentCollection}/{resourceId}/comments. commentCollection is projects or photos. Optional userEmail is sent as X-CompanyCam-User.

commentCollection.description: Comment parent collection: projects or photos.

resourceId.description: Project ID or photo ID matching commentCollection.

comments.list.title: List comments
comments.list.description: List comments on a CompanyCam project or photo via GET /{commentCollection}/{resourceId}/comments. commentCollection is projects or photos.

commentCollection.description: Comment parent collection: projects or photos.

resourceId.description: Project ID or photo ID matching commentCollection.

perPage.description: Results per page (sent as per_page, max 100).

photos.get.title: Get photo
photos.get.description: Retrieve one CompanyCam photo by ID via GET /photos/{photoId}.

photos.create.title: Add project photo from URL
photos.create.description: Add a photo to a CompanyCam project by URL via POST /projects/{projectId}/photos. Requires uri and capturedAt (unix seconds). Optional description, tags, coordinates, and userEmail (X-CompanyCam-User).

capturedAt.description: Unix timestamp when the photo was captured, sent as captured_at.

photos.description.set.title: Set photo description
photos.description.set.description: Set a CompanyCam photo description via POST /photos/{photoId}/descriptions.

photos.tags.add.title: Add photo tags
photos.tags.add.description: Attach media tags by display name via POST /photos/{photoId}/tags. Body is { tags: [strings] }.

photos.tags.list.title: List photo tags
photos.tags.list.description: List tags attached to one CompanyCam photo via GET /photos/{photoId}/tags.

perPage.description: Results per page (sent as per_page, max 100).

tags.create.title: Create photo tag
tags.create.description: Create a reusable CompanyCam media tag via POST /tags with tag.display_value.

displayValue.description: User-facing tag label sent as tag.display_value.

projects.labels.add.title: Add project labels
projects.labels.add.description: Attach project labels by display name via POST /projects/{projectId}/labels. Body is { project: { labels: [strings] } }.

projects.labels.list.title: List project labels
projects.labels.list.description: List labels on a CompanyCam project via GET /projects/{projectId}/labels.

perPage.description: Results per page (sent as per_page, max 100).

projects.photos.list.title: List project photos
projects.photos.list.description: List photos on a CompanyCam project via GET /projects/{projectId}/photos. Optional page, perPage, after, before, startDate, endDate, userIds, groupIds, and tagIds match the Core API.

perPage.description: Results per page (sent as per_page, max 100).

customers.create.title: Create customer
customers.create.description: Create a CompanyCam customer via POST /crm/customers on Core API v3. Name is required; email, notes, is_company, phone_number, address, and contacts are optional. Street, city, and state are required when address is supplied.

isCompany.description: Whether the customer represents a company (is_company).

address.description: Customer address. Street, city, and state are required when supplied.

contacts.description: Initial contacts to create for the customer.

customers.list.title: List customers
customers.list.description: List or search CompanyCam customers via GET /crm/customers on Core API v3. Optional query matches customer names and contact text.

query.description: Optional text to match against customer names and contact details.

customers.update.title: Update customer
customers.update.description: Update a CompanyCam customer via PATCH /crm/customers/{customerId} on Core API v3. Optional name, notes, and address city/postal_code are sent when set.

address.description: Supported customer address updates: city and/or postal code.

projects.tasks.create.title: Create project task
projects.tasks.create.description: Create a CompanyCam project task via POST /projects/{projectId}/tasks on Core API v3. details and projectId are required; optional assigneeIds are sent as assignee_ids. This is the project-task resource (OAuth project_tasks), not checklists.

details.description: Task details (CompanyCam limits project tasks to 250 characters).

projects.tasks.list.title: List project tasks
projects.tasks.list.description: List CompanyCam project tasks via GET /projects/{projectId}/tasks on Core API v3, including status, completion, assignees, and attached media. This is the project-task resource, not checklists.

projects.tasks.update.title: Update project task
projects.tasks.update.description: Update a CompanyCam project task via PATCH /projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId} on Core API v3. Optional details and assigneeIds (assignee_ids) add or retain assignees. This tool does not send provider assignee-removal records, so omitted users are retained.

projectId.description: CompanyCam project ID containing the task.

details.description: Updated task details (CompanyCam limits project tasks to 250 characters).

assigneeIds.description: User IDs to add or retain. Omitted users are retained; this tool never sends assignee-removal records.
